# tebib_iam_service_account (Resource)

A service account: an IAM identity for software (CI, scripts, Terraform itself), with its own access keys and policies. People join an organization by invitation instead; they can't be created here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_iam_service_account" "ci" {
  name        = "github-actions"
  description = "Deploys from CI"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique in the organization. Changing it replaces the account.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `disabled` (Boolean) A disabled account can't sign in with its keys. Default: `false`.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID (`o-...`). Default: the provider's `organization`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Service account ID (`sa-...`).
- `trn` (String) TRN, the `principal` of policy attachments.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> uses the provider's organization; <organization_id>/<id> names it.
tofu import tebib_iam_service_account.ci sa-abc123
```
